name: Valdevimbre (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally into three parts from the upper fly to the lower hoist, red at the upper hoist and lower fly and white in the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Valdevimbre (grapes and a bend on yellow).
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 10 April 2002 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 7 May 2002; it is a square flag of 1:1, tierced per bend sinister with the angle at the hoist, the fly triangle red, the central band white and the hoist triangle red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms in its colours.
